# Security reports

Do not place suspected vulnerabilities, credentials, exploit details or private data in a sandbox
issue. Stop ordinary triage and use Apache Airflow's documented private security-reporting process.
This sandbox intentionally does not reproduce that contact address; consult the
[pinned upstream security policy](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/270b2abfc258c512a0b931af425904321360d043/.github/SECURITY.md)
before a real report. The triage agent makes no exploitability assessment.
